complete_examples.text: A three-step strain method is presented to judge the load/unloading, compression/tension status of track slab elements ergodi-cally, so that the damage condition and residual strain of track slabs can be determined.

In the numerical studies, the damage distributions of track slabs in the longitudinal and lateral direction are presented, where the influence of track irregularities and track slab positions on the bridge is clarified, besides, the evolution of the damage and residual strain of a track slab subject to a moving train is revealed.
